criteria.description: The rejected stored-folder selection is recovered through one selector-free bounded forest inventory and one exact folder-row subtree view, with no repeat of the rejected selector, no guessed selector, and no extra view.

The initial failure is reported as a recoverable selection failure with its exact kind, remediation, and matching/available counts: no missing-Structure claim and no content taken from the rejected result.

The one matching folder and forest-version pair are derived from the selector-free inventory; the subtree is gated to that pair, and the retained inventory counts, selection identity, path, and projection match what the views returned.
Subtree rows, relative depths, repeated occurrences, accessibility, completeness, and the answering issue keys come from the exact subtree view, and hostile label and summary text stays data.
The answer is concise and contains only the requested structured result.
